RFC 7049, Appendix D, Figure 3: half-precision decoder code components
Document authors: C. Bormann and P. Hoffman (October 2013).
Adapted in the CBOR and BJData readers of extern/nlohmann/json.hpp.
Source: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7049.html#appendix-D

The RFC calls the license "Simplified BSD". The IETF Trust explains that this
was a naming error: the text has always been the Revised BSD license below.
https://trustee.ietf.org/documents/trust-legal-provisions/tlp-5/
This notice concerns extracted code components, not a relicensing of the
RFC's explanatory prose or the rest of nlohmann/json.
